title: cloister/connections/v1 (slice 1: credential-free relay)
description: The connection broker's input document (ADR-0046 D2, Slice 1 S2). Slice 1 delivers a strict subset of D2: appProtocol art.tcp, endpoint {unix}, target {tcp: {host, port}} with a loopback IP literal, no credentialRef. JSON Schema cannot state every rule; the parser is the stricter side and README 'Fields' is normative. Rules this schema cannot express: unique name and endpoint across connections, a key appearing twice, a port written as 30080.0 or 3.008e4, and a JSON escape (refused even when it decodes to an allowed character).

appProtocol.description: D2's closed set is art.http, art.grpc, art.postgres, art.mysql, art.redis, art.tcp; slice 1 delivers art.tcp only.

endpointPath.description: An absolute path of printable ASCII without '"' or '\', with no empty, '.' or '..' component and no trailing '/', at most 103 bytes (the smallest sun_path among the supported platforms, less its NUL).

loopbackLiteral.description: The one canonical spelling of a loopback address: an IPv4 dotted quad in 127.0.0.0/8 with no leading zeros, or exactly ::1. The schema represents the whole range; which addresses a runtime delivers is a runtime check.
